required_inferences: Treat uppercase/lowercase as lit/dark states and read each five-letter card as one value.
Interpret TURNBACKTHREE as an operation on the still-unused dial text, not as the final answer.
rejected_hypotheses: Reading lowercase as lit or reversing the five positions fails to produce a grammatical instruction.
independent_check: Uppercase-as-1 with the west/left position most significant yields TURNBACKTHREE; shifting KDUERU backward three gives the six-letter port HARBOR.
